lines: 第二十三章：四大势力，县衙招新
河西，一重山地界。
郑满仓伏身在地，弯弓搭箭，瞄准了前方的锦鸡。
嗖！
箭矢飞出，擦肩而过。
射空了！
受惊的锦鸡高高跃起，双翼一扇，眨眼便消失在了远处。
“小兄弟，是死是活，看你自己了，我老郑只能做到这步了。”
看着远去的锦鸡，郑满仓神情平静，
他口中叼着的狗尾巴草，落到了地上。
“差不多了，撤！”
郑满仓看了看天色，决定下山。
他转过身，朝着二重山方向看了一眼。
突然，他的动作停滞下来。
郑满仓一脸惊疑，还没等他细看，对面的人倒是率先招呼他：
“过来搭把手！”
郑满仓呆愣地看着那被拖拽着的庞大熊尸，机械回应道。
陆川放下手中由藤蔓编成的藤网，一屁股坐在地上，喘着粗气。
以这大黑熊足有400斤往上的体重，就算陆川力气不小，也废了老大的劲，才把它从二重山的熊洞拉到一重山。
刚刚出了二重山不久，他正好看见了郑满仓。
郑满仓快步来到陆川身旁，低声问道：
“那些人呢？”
陆川面露迷茫，
“什么人？”
看着陆川的神情，郑满仓不再多问，而是把目光看向那熊尸：
“好本事！没想到几大武馆还没动手，这熊瞎子就死在你的手上了。”
他对着陆川竖起大拇指。
眼前青年的这番表现，也让郑满仓对自己的选择暗自庆幸。
锦上添花，不如雪中送炭。
从陆川敢正面硬刚狼群，他就知道，这人以后的成就必然不斐。
“跟我一起把这大黑熊弄下山，我分你两成。”
陆川没有解释太多，直接拍板。
郑满仓直接答应下来。
出一膀子力气，就能获得两成利。
不用多说，彼此心照不宣。
这是陆川对郑满仓做出警示的回报。
就这样，两人并着肩，拖拽着熊尸，往山下去。

Chapter 23: Four major forces, county government recruits new people
Hexi is a mountainous area.
Zheng Mancang lay on the ground, bent his bow and arrow, and aimed at the golden pheasant in front of him.
Whoosh!
The arrow flew out and passed by.
Shot empty!
The frightened golden pheasant jumped high, flapped its wings, and disappeared into the distance in the blink of an eye.
"Little brother, it's up to you whether you live or die. I, Lao Zheng, can only do this."
Looking at the golden pheasant going away, Zheng Mancang looked calm.
"Bah!"
The dogtail grass he was holding in his mouth fell to the ground.
"It's almost time, retreat!"
Zheng Mancang looked at the sky and decided to go down the mountain.
He turned around and glanced in the direction of Erzhong Mountain.
Suddenly, his movements stopped.
"Is this...?"
Zheng Mancang looked surprised. Before he could take a closer look, the person opposite was the first to greet him:
"Come here and help me!"
"Coming..."
Zheng Mancang stared blankly at the huge bear corpse being dragged, and responded mechanically.
Lu Chuan put down the vine net made of vines in his hand and sat down on the ground, breathing heavily.
With this big black bear weighing over 400 kilograms, even if Lu Chuan was quite strong, he still had to use up his strength to pull it from the bear cave in Erzhong Mountain to Yi Zhongshan.
Not long after he left Erzhong Mountain, he happened to see Zheng Mancang.
Zheng Mancang quickly came to Lu Chuan's side and asked in a low voice:
"Where are those people?"
Lu Chuan looked confused,
"Who?"
Seeing Lu Chuan's expression, Zheng Mancang no longer asked any more questions, but looked at the bear corpse:
"What a skill! I didn't expect that this blind bear would die in your hands before several major martial arts schools took action."
He gave Lu Chuan a thumbs up.
The performance of the young man in front of him also made Zheng Mancang secretly glad for his choice.
The icing on the cake is not as good as providing help when it is timely.
From the moment Lu Chuan dared to confront the wolves, he knew that this man would achieve great things in the future.
"Come with me and get this big black bear down the mountain, and I'll give you 20%."
Lu Chuan didn't explain much and just made the decision.
"It's done!"
Zheng Mancang agreed directly.
If you work hard, you can get 20% profit.
Needless to say, they understand each other tacitly.
This was Lu Chuan's reward for warning Zheng Mancang.
In this way, the two of them dragged the bear carcass side by side down the mountain.
